Surah Al Kausar (سورة الكوثر) Read Online

Surah Al Kausar is 108 Surah and found in the 30th Parah of the Holy Quran. This Surah contains 3 verses 11 words 42 letters, and it is revealed in “Makka” so-referred as the “Makki” Surah. And this surah is called A River in Paradise.

اِنَّاۤ اَعْطَیْنٰكَ الْكَوْثَرَؕ(۱) فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَ انْحَرْؕ(۲) اِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْاَبْتَرُ۠(۳)
